title: Jeff's Farm — EN/SN/ND (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar Shona Ndebele language learning warm baritone storytelling 100bpm Zimbabwe farm portrait trilingual walking bass brushed drums
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Jeff was up before the light came over
He walked the rows before the workers arrived
Not because he didn't trust them
But because that's what a farming man does in his life

[Verse 2 - Shona, with English translations]
Jeff akamutswa asati kwedza (Jeff woke before dawn)
Akafamba mumijenya asati vashandi vasvika (He walked the rows before workers arrived)
Kwaisava nekusatenda (It was not about distrust)
Izvi ndizvo zvinoita murume wepurazi muupenyu hwake (This is what a farming man does in his life)
Pavakataura, vose vakateerera (When he spoke, all listened)
Kwaisava nekutya asi rukudzo rwakapiwa zvishoma nezvishoma (Not from fear but from respect earned slowly)

[Chorus - Ndebele, with English translations]
UFarm kaJeff (Jeff's farm)
Lapho abasebenzi bebuya khona njalo ekuseni (Where the workers came back every morning)
UFarm kaJeff (Jeff's farm)
Lapho inhlonipho kwakuyinto oyitholayo futhi uyigcine (Where respect was earned and kept)
UFarm kaJeff (Jeff's farm)
Uthuli olubomvu lotshela izindaba (Where red dust tells the stories)
Eziwaziyo abantu abaphila khona (That the people there already know)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Between the two of them they held a world together
Shona: Pakati pavo, vakabata nyika pamwe chete (Between them, they held a world together)
Ndebele: Phakathi kwabo, babambe umhlaba ndawonye (Between them, they held a world together)

[Outro - all three]
English: Jeff's farm — still in how they carry themselves
Shona: Purazi raJeff — riri mune zvavaita (Jeff's farm — still in what they do)
Ndebele: UFarm kaJeff — usekukhona (Jeff's farm — still here)
